messages.subject: Project Beacon - legal DD report (final)
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Our final legal due diligence report is attached. Headlines: the business is well run and records are in good order. Four items need specific protection in the SPA - (1) the Halcyon change-of-control clause (now covered by a customer consent letter), (2) the open HMRC R&D enquiry, (3) BRCGS certificate renewal timing, and (4) an intimated employment claim. We recommend specific indemnities for (2) and (4). None is a deal-breaker.

Happy to walk you and Margaret through it.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0815
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
